podcast.body: Their first single for Groove Records. It had commercial potential but failed to become a hit because Johnny Ray released a different song with an almost identical title around the same time, leading to customer confusion. "Mickey and Sylvia's first single, Groove, working in the rain, had the potential to be a big hit in the eyes of the record company. But unfortunately for them, Johnny Ray put this out at around the same time."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
